author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

**This is a proof-of-principle, it should not be merged as-is.**

Use the MLPF model modified to support padded inputs (cms-sw/cmssw#52009).

On ROCm, pad the inputs to rocmMaxElements, so MIGraphX compiles the model only
once, and run the larger events on a CPU session, created on first use.

The other backends are unchanged.

This PR builds on top of, and currently includes:
  - #51968
  - #52006 

It also requires:
  - cms-sw/cmsdist#10873
title: [do not merge] Run MLPF on ROCm with padded inputs and a CPU fallback
